+"""Interactive controller for the BEHAVIOR-1K packing_meal_for_delivery episode.
+
+Run with ``python -u /app/output/gen.py`` and send one JSON request per line.
+The client and episode stay live for the duration of the process. Requests:
+  {"op":"obs"}
+  {"op":"base", "x":0, "y":0, "yaw":0, "seconds":0.1}
+  {"op":"ee", "left":[x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw,g], "right":[...]}
+  {"op":"joint", "rows":[[...25 values...], ...], "dt":0.1}
+All observations and action results are written under /app/output/records.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/output/records"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+robot = Robot()
+counter = 0
+
+def state():
+    o = robot.get_obs(video="frames")
+    return o
+
+def save_images(images, label):
+    global counter
+    from PIL import Image
+    counter += 1
+    d = os.path.join(OUT, f"{counter:03d}_{label}")
+    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, frame in images.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(os.path.join(d, cam.replace(":", "_") + ".jpg"), quality=93)
+    return d
+
+def compact(o):
+    p = o.meta.get("proprio", {})
+    now = p.get("now", [])
+    return {
+        "step": o.meta.get("step"), "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "done": o.meta.get("done"), "reason": o.meta.get("reason"),
+        "proprio_layout": p.get("layout", []), "proprio": now,
+        "cameras": o.meta.get("cameras", {}),
+    }
+
+def joint_action(rows, dt=0.1, note="manual joint target"):
+    r = robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt,
+                     interpolate="hold", note=note)
+    return r
+
+def response(r, label):
+    path = save_images(r.last, label) if r.last else None
+    p = r.proprio
+    return {"meta": r.meta, "proprio_last": None if p is None or not len(p) else p[-1].tolist(),
+            "image_dir": path}
+
+def process(req):
+    op = req["op"]
+    if op == "obs":
+        o = robot.get_obs(video="frames")
+        path = save_images(o.last, "obs")
+        return {**compact(o), "image_dir": path}
+    if op == "base":
+        o = robot.get_obs(video="frames")
+        q = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+        row = q[:25].copy()
+        row[:3] = [req.get("x", 0), req.get("y", 0), req.get("yaw", 0)]
+        dt = float(req.get("seconds", 0.1))
+        if dt > 10: raise ValueError("base chunk must be <= 10 seconds")
+        r = joint_action([row], dt=dt, note="base reposition")
+        return response(r, "base")
+    if op == "joint":
+        r = joint_action(req["rows"], dt=float(req.get("dt", 0.1)), note=req.get("note", "joint action"))
+        return response(r, "joint")
+    if op == "ee":
+        o = robot.get_obs(video="frames")
+        p = o.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+        l = [p[35], p[36], p[37], p[38], p[39], p[40], p[41], 1.0]
+        rr = [p[42], p[43], p[44], p[45], p[46], p[47], p[48], 1.0]
+        if "left" in req: l = req["left"]
+        if "right" in req: rr = req["right"]
+        poses = np.asarray([l + rr], dtype=np.float32)
+        r = robot.submit("ee_pose", poses, note=req.get("note", "end effector move"))
+        return response(r, "ee")
+    if op == "status":
+        return robot.status()
+    raise ValueError("unknown op: " + op)
+
+print(json.dumps({"connected": robot.base, "spec": robot.spec(), "status": robot.status()}), flush=True)
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        ans = process(json.loads(line))
+        print(json.dumps(ans), flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
